_doc: The role config of the example agents (verdict_desk/seal.py reads it with Session(config=...)). One role, `reader`, plays an open-weight model; it drives Otari's web fetch tool, so it is a tool role and the tool cap applies. Edit the model id to any open-weight catalog id.
_send_user_doc: false so an ordinary key works. With a service key, OTARI_SEND_USER=1 bills the role to its own end user, `byo-reader`.
